title: Figure 40: Frequency of Object Sightings by Angle of Elevation of the Sun
description: Histogram of the "Number of Object Sightings" (0–300) against the "Angle of Elevation of The Sun" in 10-degree intervals, running from -90 through 0 (Sun rise) and +90 back to 0 (Sun set) and -90. An outline histogram shows "All object sightings", with a grid-hatched histogram of "Unknown object sightings" beneath it; the largest peak falls just after sunset. Caption: "FIGURE 40 FREQUENCY OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY ANGLE OF ELEVATION OF THE SUN, INTERVALS OF 10 DEGREES OF ANGLE"; drawing A-7536.
